PDF export now generates multi-page PDF with: Cover+KPIs+Charts (Page 1), Providers (Page 2), Drivers (Page 3), Incidents (Page 4), Attempts (Page 5), Quality (Page 6), SLA (Page 7), AI Analysis (Page 8)

rca_of_the_issue.bug: PDF export failing with 'TypeError: pdf.autoTable is not a function'
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: jspdf-autotable 5.x requires explicit plugin application via applyPlugin(jsPDF) function. The original code used 'await import(jspdf-autotable)' which doesn't attach the autoTable method to jsPDF prototype in modern bundlers.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Changed import pattern from 'await import(jspdf-autotable)' to 'const { applyPlugin } = await import(jspdf-autotable); applyPlugin(jsPDF);'
